messages:
Maria Gomez: Quick handoff for VIP go-live (NovaHealth) tomorrow 09:00 PT. Load test at 13:00 PT expected ~3x normal traffic. I'm on until 11:00 PT and will hand to Dan mid-day, Rahul covers evenings.
Dan Lee: I can take 11:00–19:00 PT. I'll be available for the load test window. Any pre-scale instructions?
Maria Gomez: Pre-scale dedicated pool to 3 nodes, enable graceful-fallback to quantized model variant. Console link: https://console.redwood.io/orgs/acme/rollouts/546. Runbook will be in the doc.
Sara Ngu: Reminder: NovaHealth SLA requires 99.9% uptime and p95 token latency <=100ms. If p95 >200ms for >5m, please escalate to eng-sre oncall.
Rahul Patel: I'll pick up 19:00–03:00 PT. Ping me 10m before the load test start so I can be on watch for the tail-end metrics.
Dan Lee: @Rahul yup I'll watch the first 30m after the test then handover.
Rahul Patel: Quick sanity check I'll run during the handover: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/health -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' | jq .
Oncall Bot: Reminder: Scheduled load test for 'NovaHealth' at 2026-03-18T20:00:00Z (13:00 PT) — duration 1h. Auto-alert: page eng-oncall if errors > 5%.
Sara Ngu: Can we add a temporary rate-limit for unauthenticated endpoints? Last time a partner webhook flooded us.
Maria Gomez: Done — firewall rule added to limit unauth traffic and restrict partner IPs 203.0.113.0/24. Rollback tag: rollback/novahealth-firewall if needed.
Dan Lee: I'll follow this quick checklist during the test:
```
1) Monitor p95 latency in Console
2) Check per-model error-rate and top error messages
3) Ensure fallback policies are active and functioning
4) Snapshot metrics and logs at 0/15/30/60m
```
Maria Gomez: Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/novahealth-go-live — includes escalation tree and contact numbers. If we hit sustained errors, page eng-oncall and message @sre-lead.
Rahul Patel: Heads-up: one dedicated node shows driver v0.9.8 (slightly older). Not blocking but watch for CUDA OOM signatures in logs.
Dan Lee: If we see OOMs I'll trigger a node reimage and shift traffic via routing policy. Any DB migrations in this window?
Maria Gomez: No DB changes. Model rollout from v1.2 -> v1.3 on a gradual canary (10/30/60).
Sara Ngu: I'll monitor SLA dashboards and post a short status every 15m in this thread during the test.
Maria Gomez: Thanks — if anything surfaces after 03:00 PT, SRE oncall is @sre-oncall. Leaving extended notes in the handoff doc. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Deployment scheduled: model-rollout/novahealth v1.3 starting 2026-03-18T18:30:00Z.
Maria Gomez: Closing handoff. Contacts + quick checklist are in the doc. Ping in thread for any last-minute swaps.
